item.title: Historic Winner of Texas Oil Regulator Seat Wants Faster Permits
item.description: The first Democrat in 36 years to win a seat on the commission that governs the oil and gas industry in Texas said he plans to work with his Republican colleagues to speed up permitting in the state.
item.dc:creator: David Wethe

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Huang Behavior Complaints
item.description:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF
About two decades ago, two Nvidia employees complained about how then-Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang treated his staff. Stephen Pettigrew, the first in-house lawyer hired by Nvidia, said he observed Huang regularly verbally abusing and intimidating employees, according to court documents filed in the Superior Court of California. Pettigrew alleged he was fired for raising concerns about the conduct of Nvidia executives, while the company cited performance issues for his termination, according to court documents.
On today’s episode: Ian King, Bloomberg News US Semiconductor Reporter Mark Gurman, Bloomberg News Managing Editor of Consumer Technology Anna Wong, Bloomberg Economics Chief US Economist Michael Ball, Bloomberg News Macro Strategist (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Why Are the Houthis So Hard for Saudi Arabia to Defeat?
item.description: After four years of relative calm, the war pitting Yemen’s Houthi militia against the country’s internationally recognized government and its backer Saudi Arabia is raging again.
item.dc:creator: Veena Ali-Khan, Paul Wallace and Gerry Doyle

item.title: Lawmakers On Verge of Deal to Ban Chinese Cars, Moreno Says
item.description: US lawmakers are closing in on an agreement to shut China’s fast-growing automakers out of the US market that avoids entangling Mercedes-Benz Group AG, Senator Bernie Moreno said.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis

item.title: The Congressional Investigations Investors Need to Watch
item.description: Over 300 companies could be Democratic targets next year.
item.dc:creator: Nathan R Dean

item.title: EU Nears New Trade Power to Block Access to Its Single Market
item.description: The European Union is finalizing plans to create a new power that would enable it to rapidly hit back against trade attacks from countries such as China, as the bloc seeks to address its massive deficit with the Asian nation.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Nardelli

item.title: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: Mark Gurman, Bloomberg News managing editor of consumer technology, said that Apple is working on its own AI agent to perform tasks for consumers, acting as a consumer's 'own personal assistant' throughout their digital lives. Gurman said that there is a lot of risk for Apple because of its slow pace getting into the AI space, adding that it will be hard for consumers to undo established relationships with other AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Swiss Farmers Set to Lose Voice in Government With New Minister
item.description: Swiss farmers could lose some of their traditional sway over the country’s politics, as the sector’s most prominent member in government is set to be replaced by a politician without a strong agricultural background.
item.dc:creator: Bastian Benrath-Wright

item.title: Trump Threatens to Tax Firms Building Data Centers Abroad: Full Presser
item.description: President Trump delivered a wide-ranging briefing to reporters after returning from his trip to Asia, where he held a landmark summit with China's President Xi and Russia's President Putin. President Trump told reporters he plans to tax on firms building data centers abroad and said that US and China are working on a 'comprehensive' deal on chips. Trump also backed both former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, saying would like to see Huang return to the chipmaker and that he has not lost confidence in Lutnick. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Defends Putin Ties as Russia Steps Up Ukraine Attacks
item.description: President Donald Trump defended his relationship with Vladimir Putin, repeatedly insisting that the Russian leader wants to end the war in Ukraine despite Moscow’s latest deadly assault.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Hadriana Lowenkron

item.title: Trump Backs Lutnick After Senator’s Criticism of Chip Smuggling
item.description: President Donald Trump defended Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s role at the center of a scandal involving AI chips smuggled to China.
item.dc:creator: Laura Curtis

item.title: Trump Threatens to Tax Firms Building Data Centers Abroad
item.description: President Trump vowed to tax American companies that build data centers in other countries, though he didn’t detail exactly how such a threat would be carried out and what legal authority the government might have to impose one. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Plays Down Tensions With Vance Over Iran War Critique
item.description: President Donald Trump denied a report that he voiced unhappiness with Vice President JD Vance for blaming the Republicans’ midterm wipeout on the war with Iran.
item.dc:creator: Kate Sullivan and Josh Wingrove

item.title: Trump Says Huang Should Return to Nvidia After ‘Big Apology’
item.description: President Donald Trump called for Jensen Huang to make a big apology and return as chief executive officer of Nvidia Corp., even as the prospect remains highly unlikely.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Courtney Subramanian

item.title: Trump Says US Close to Mexico Trade Deal, Less So With Canada
item.description: President Donald Trump said the US is closing in on a trade deal with Mexico, while indicating that separate negotiations with Canada are not as far along.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove

item.title: Burnham’s Brush With Europe Shows How Hard Rejoining Would Be
item.description: Andy Burnham experienced his first encounter with the harsh realities of talks with the European Union after last-minute wrangling over the final details of a youth visa program threatened to overshadow his landmark Brussels summit.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Chaplain, Lucy White and Andrea Palasciano

item.title: Indian Man Gets 19 Years for Plot to Kill Sikh Activist
item.description: An Indian man was sentenced to more than 19 years in prison after admitting to his role in a foiled 2023 plot to kill a Sikh activist in New York.
item.dc:creator: Bob Van Voris

item.title: Democrat Warns DOJ, FBI to Retain Documents Ahead of Probes
item.description: A senior House Democrat told the Justice Department, FBI, Department of Homeland Security and other agencies to preserve all documents — including communications conducted on non-governmental messaging apps — amid allegations that top officials have ignored or sought to evade federal record-keeping laws.
item.dc:creator: Caitlin Reilly and Cam Kettles
